frame.Description: Index of the frame in the run's released clip of this view (videos/), from 0; frame 0 is the movement start. Where the source video began after the movement start, the clip starts with black frames (manifest <view>_lead_black_frames) and the first row is the first frame with an image; frames without an image have no row. A row describes the image of its frame: where a clip's first image repeats the next one (a seek artefact of the clip cut), the two rows are equal. Labels of clips with vicon_valid or <view>_valid false (manifest) are not verified and can be misaligned; the benchmark uses vicon_valid & <view>_valid.

time.Description: Capture time of the frame: run time, seconds since the movement start, through the video-game clock alignment (manifest <view>_align_err).

left_shoulder_x.Description: Horizontal position of the left shoulder joint (VICON proxy: LSHO, low-pass filtered at 6 Hz), image px of the full frame, origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down; n/a where VICON has no position; projected with the camera of this view (cameras/), so it can lie outside the image and is n/a behind the camera.

left_shoulder_y.Description: Vertical position of the left shoulder joint (VICON proxy: LSHO, low-pass filtered at 6 Hz), image px of the full frame, origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down; n/a where VICON has no position; projected with the camera of this view (cameras/), so it can lie outside the image and is n/a behind the camera.

left_shoulder_visible.Description: Whether every marker of the joint has a white marker blob within 8 px of its projection. Blobs were detected on every third source frame of the clips valid in this view; n/a on the other frames and where the point has no position.

Levels.0: not visible (occluded, or no blob near the projection)

Levels.0: not visible (occluded, or no blob near the projection)
